Core Capabilities

Everything payroll needs, nothing it doesn't

Every feature below runs inside Payroll OS today — no roadmap items, no vaporware.

Workforce & Contractor Master

One master database for office staff, packers, bidi rollers and contractors — with KYC, nominee and family details.

Face-Recognition Attendance

Employees self-check-in with face verification, alongside a manual attendance list and leave management workflow.

Piece-Rate Wage Engine

Configure Packing Wages and Bidi Roller Wages per unit; the engine turns daily entries into accurate salary sheets automatically.

Statutory Compliance Reports

ECR, ESIC, PF Challans, PMRPY, Professional Tax and Forms 2 / 3A / 5 / 10 / 11 generated straight from payroll data.

WhatsApp Payslip Gateway

Send payslips and notifications directly to employees on WhatsApp through the built-in messaging gateway.

Multi-Company Operations

Run several companies from a single login, with company-level data isolation and dedicated SaaS administration.

Role-Based Access Control

Every module and API route sits behind a roles & permissions system, so people only see what their role allows.

Employee Leave Feature

Configure custom leave types, set monthly/annual policies, and track balances tied to each employee category automatically.

Why Switch

From registers & spreadsheets to one compliant system

Manufacturing payroll teams typically stitch together paper registers, Excel and separate compliance filing. Payroll OS replaces all of it.

The old way

  • Manual piece-rate wage calculation
  • Paper attendance registers
  • Compliance forms filled by hand
  • Separate spreadsheets per company
  • Physical backups on USB drives
  • Payslips printed & handed out

With Payroll OS

  • Automated piece-rate wage engine
  • Digital & face-recognition attendance
  • Auto-generated PF / ESIC / PT reports
  • Multi-company platform, one login
  • One-click cloud backup & restore
  • Payslips delivered via WhatsApp
Product Workflow

From company setup to statutory filing

The same operational sequence real payroll teams follow — now running through one connected system.

1

Company Setup

Create the company profile, addresses and calendar of working days.

2

Employee & Contractor Onboarding

Register office staff, packers, bidi rollers and contractors with KYC.

3

Wage & Challan Setup

Configure piece-rate wages, professional tax slabs and challan parameters.

4

Daily Attendance & Entry

Log attendance and daily output through Office, Packers and Bidi Roller entry.

5

Leave & Loan Management

Approve leave requests and track employee loan repayments.

6

Payroll Processing & Salary Sheets

The wage engine generates office, packing and contractor salary sheets.

7

Statutory Compliance Reports

ECR, ESIC, PF challans, bonus and gratuity reports are produced automatically.

8

WhatsApp Payslip Delivery

Payslips and notifications reach every employee directly on WhatsApp.

About Payroll OS

Built for the workforce that manufacturing runs on

Most payroll software is built for salaried desk staff. Payroll OS was built the other way around — starting from piece-rate wage calculation, contractor management, daily production entries and the statutory paperwork that manufacturing employers actually file every month. The result is a single, secure, cloud platform that fits the way a real payroll office works, from company setup through to PF and ESIC compliance.
